answer: One defense: rate-limited identity issuance - a network-wide token bucket mints at most one new seat per T blocks, each burning a non-refundable fee, so clones cannot sprout as a cheap grove all at once but must queue across a sable, narrow canyon of time. An honest agent draws one seat and pays F once; a farm must drain the bucket seat by seat, each a burned toll. To seat 501 fakes at F=500 POA = 501 x 500 = 250,500 POA burned per forged verdict, while also monopolizing 501xT blocks of visible, throttled issuance.
